ask: mkae a pol for the evnings plz
sentence: A shared poll where everyone taps the evenings that work for a meeting, anyone can add another evening, and the vote counts show live.
use_when: Picking an evening for a house or group meeting
Finding which days work for most people
Letting people vote on more than one option and add their own
dont_use_when: Choosing exactly one winner with a single vote per person
Booking a time on a calendar with exact hours or reminders
